content.what_it_is: MATLAB animation script for the FUNWAVE-TVD levee_1d solitary wave case that renders 301 eta snapshots into png frames. User input section (L4-L22) sets fdir='../input_files/output/' (L9), plotDir=fdir+'plots/' (L12), nfile=1:301 (L15), plot_color_bars=true (L18). Loads dep.out negated (dep=-load(...), L26), takes row 2 to strip the artificial y points of the 2D-run 1D setup (L29, comment L28); dx=0.08 with x=(0:n-1)*dx (L32-L33). Wavemaker marker is a vertical dashed red line at x=4 (L36-L37, plotted L72, labeled L75-L76). Figure is 11x2.5 inches (L40-L42). Creates plotDir if missing (L46-L48). Loop i=1:301 (L50-L87): zero-padded filename (L55), loads eta_<fnum> (L58-L59), takes row 2 (L62), prints progress 'READING IN: eta_...' (L64), fills the bathymetry as a grey polygon between dep and -0.5 (L67), fills the water body cyan between eta and dep (L71), draws wavemaker line (L72), labels axes (L78-L79), sets ylim([-0.45,1]) (L81), and prints plotDir/surf_<fnum>.png (L84-L85).
entities: dep negated bathymetry L26 then row-2 slice L29
eta loaded then row-2 slice L59, L62

equations.ref: negate depth to plot as bed elevation
cyan water polygon between eta and dep

unresolved: L55 indexes nfile(num) where num=nfile(i) (L52); since nfile=1:301 this equals nfile(i) here, but for any non-contiguous nfile this double-indexing would be a bug
plot_color_bars (L18) is declared in the user input section but never used in this script
the loop bound is hard-coded 1:301 (L50) instead of 1:length(nfile), duplicating L15
m from size (L27) is unused after the row-2 slice
